title: Discovering formally verified quantum programs with AI
title_zh: 用AI发现经形式化验证的量子程序

paragraphs.en: The timeline by which quantum computers can solve breakthrough problems in science depends on improved quantum algorithms as much as on better hardware [ 148 , 149 ] . Such algorithmic advances are typically achieved through many years of expert human collaboration [ 150 , 151 ] . In mathematics and computer science, large language models have accelerated progress through automated discovery loops [ 152 , 153 ] . However, quantum algorithms can only be evaluated by classical computers on restricted or small instances [ 154 , 155 ] . Here we demonstrate automated discovery of quantum programs beyond these regimes including order-of-magnitude improvements on scientific applications. To achieve this, we build a quantum program library in the Lean theorem prover in which large language model agents synthesize novel programs against formal problem specifications and verify their correctness and cost. Agent teams collaborate, sharing results and knowledge through wikis and discussing ideas at organized conferences. Our results improve on prior baselines for parallel search [ 156 ] (up to 1.4 × 1.4\times ), quantum arithmetic [ 157 ] ( 290 × 290\times ), and simulations relevant to fusion, photochemistry and drug-metabolism by 11 × 11\times , 8 × 8\times and 2.5 × 2.5\times respectively. Combining human and artificial intelligence at scale, under the rigor of mathematical proof, lets researchers design algorithms that today’s classical and quantum computers cannot test, shortening the path to practical quantum computation.
paragraphs.zh: 量子计算机何时能够解决科学中的突破性问题，既取决于更好的硬件，也同样取决于改进的量子算法 [148, 149]。 这类算法进展通常需要多年专家人类的协作才能实现 [150, 151]。 在数学和计算机科学领域，大语言模型已通过自动化发现循环加速了进展 [152, 153]。 然而，量子算法只能在受限或小规模的实例上由经典计算机进行评估 [154, 155]。 在此，我们展示了超越这些范围的量子程序的自动化发现，包括在科学应用上实现数量级的改进。 为实现这一目标，我们在 Lean 定理证明器中构建了一个量子程序库，其中大语言模型智能体根据形式化的问题规范合成新程序，并验证其正确性与成本。 智能体团队相互协作，通过维基共享结果与知识，并在有组织的会议上讨论想法。 我们的结果改进了先前的基线：并行搜索 [156]（最高 1.4 倍 1.4\times）、量子算术 [157]（290 倍 290\times），以及与聚变、光化学和药物代谢相关的模拟分别提升 11 倍 11\times、8 倍 8\times 和 2.5 倍 2.5\times。 在数学证明的严格性下大规模结合人类智能与人工智能，让研究者能够设计出当今经典计算机和量子计算机都无法测试的算法，从而缩短通往实用量子计算的路径。
